acceptance.item: P6-MERGE-T13-01: link states of T13 show the plain-markup names (no MathML, A-12) until the reader's first action
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T13.spec.ts > regressions > /<link>: the names of the real form are typeset with MathML before the first interaction (A-12) (the 3 Atlas links and /embed/satake/?g=A3&x=1.3&t=1.2.3); site/tests/e2e/M9.spec.ts > regressions > M9: an instance link shows the names of its catalogue typeset with MathML before the first interaction (A-12); site/tests/unit/tools/T13.test.ts > regressions > names.mjs writes one file per board holding the typeset names of exactly that board's catalogue, as satake-names.json typesets them
acceptance.evidence: Severity major. Red at base d8102c0: 6 browser tests failed (math Expected 1/2, Received 0 for su*(4), so*(16), e6(-26), and e6(6) on M9 b8); the unit test failed (writeSatakeNamesByBoard is not a function). Cause: the browser could only fetch the whole typeset-names section (5230 B), which could not fit in hydration within 90 kB, so P6-RT-07-01 left link states with plain markup. Fix: names.mjs also writes satake-names/<board>.json; t13/names.ts lazily loads one board's chunk (487 to 833 B); readLink loads it during hydration when a link changes the pair. Green: all pass. A mutant without the readLink load fails all 5 tool and embed tests. Sizes: link-size tests green (default 87943 B, links 88594 to 88776 B, all at most 90000). RT-07 sweep: 167 links, 0 over, max 88776 B. npm run size: 87.3 to 87.9 kB on /tools/satake/, /embed/satake/ and M9. The default route fetches no names chunk and keeps its server-typeset names. Commit 5872217.

acceptance.item: P6-MERGE-T13-02: the decoration's paint buttons carry data-board="numbers" with data-value 1 or 0, which misstates them (SPEC 4.0, 6.3)
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T13.spec.ts > regressions > the paint buttons of the decoration are controls, not node buttons: data-control "paint", data-paint, data-colour; no "numbers" board on T13
acceptance.evidence: Severity minor. Red on the base build: received 'data-control=- data-paint=- data-node=2 data-board=numbers data-value=1' and so on for the 6 paint buttons. Cause: the paint buttons were tagged as numbers-game node buttons although the copy shows no value and plays neither game. Fix: DecorationDiagram now gives them data-control="paint", data-paint (the label), data-colour and data-can-act, with no data-node, data-board or data-value. Keyboard, focus and names are unchanged. Green: T13.spec.ts plus T13-keyboard.spec.ts 47 passed (one tab stop, arrows, Home/End, Enter/Space focus, announcements), M9.spec.ts 38, nojs and a11y for satake and M9 9, RT-10 hooks regression green. Selectors were updated to the new hooks with the same asserted values. Commit 3751e08.

deviations.spec: existing test assertion (T13.spec.ts 'every node button carries data-node, data-board, data-value and data-can-act ...')
deviations.what: The node-button count went from 6 + 6 + 2 to 6 + 2. The six paint buttons are now checked separately: data-control paint, data-paint, data-colour, data-can-act, and no data-node, data-board or data-value. The 320-pixel hit-area loop now also covers button[data-control="paint"].
deviations.why: The decoration's buttons stop being node buttons by the design of P6-MERGE-T13-02. Every button is still checked, more strictly than before.

deviations.what: scripts/names.mjs gains writeSatakeNamesByBoard (called from its command-line run, not from writeGenerated) and a realFormEntry helper shared by both writers.
deviations.why: The per-board split must be made where the typeset names are made. satake-names.json and names.json are byte-identical to the base, and P6-A2's two-file test of writeGenerated is unchanged.

openQuestions: Challenge.svelte still reads the game board and the restricted board together as 'populations' while the restricted panel is open (b7, b12), interleaved by label. The numbers group is now empty on T13. No reach, distinct or mixed-signs Challenge exists on T13; a group hook would be a change under site/src/components/lesson/ (recorded in the fragment).

The per-board loaders add 628 B to T13's chunk, so headroom on /tools/satake/ is now about 2.1 kB for the default and 1.2 kB for the largest link (D8). Agents changing shared chunks (ToolFrame) should re-measure.
handoff: Outside the t13 component area, only scripts/names.mjs changed (an added per-board writer; generated bytes unchanged), and M9.spec.ts got its deco locator, one count selector, its header comment and one added regression test. Nothing in ToolFrame, T12, the glossary, the confusion or history pages, or M9 content was touched. Both findings are fixed with no needs-decision. The proposed fix for 01 was followed (one chunk per board, loaded during hydration). For 02 the proposed control design was followed, with data-paint holding the label and data-can-act kept so M9's frozen-state assertions stand. The lens rerun should read the decoration through data-control="paint"/data-paint and expect link states to fetch one board chunk (at most 833 B).
